description: Northstar OS commerce logic — pricing, economics, catalog, margin, opportunity scoring.
rules: All unit economics computed backend-side before render (fee_engine.py, demand_estimator.py, competition_analytics.py, portfolio_analytics.py).
Economics confidence tiers: estimated (estimated_fee_stack), provisional (needs_fee_verification — FBA fee EXCLUDED), unavailable (missing_amazon_price | missing_costco_cogs).
Pack/Variant Match gate: estimated economics require exact product-equivalence fingerprint (brand, formula/flavor, net weight, pack/count, UPC/EAN).
Costco cost basis hierarchy: invoice_confirmed > costco_online > estimated > unavailable. Fuzzy matches = candidate_match (research only).
Profit tiering + ROI/margin gating apply ONLY to 'estimated' confidence rows.
Category resolution: browse node → verified; breadcrumb-only → inferred ('confirm in Seller Central'); none → default Everything Else 15% (default_category note).
